description: Official local MCP server for the SpicyAPI public API

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_asset_delete
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete one asset from the library this key reaches. Its spicy://a/<id> uri stops working in new requests at once and the stored file is removed; there is no undo. In a team library, developers can delete only what they saved.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_asset_rename
tool_signatures.description: Change an asset

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_asset_save
tool_signatures.description: Keep a file in the asset library this key reaches (personal, or the team

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_assets_list
tool_signatures.description: List files in the asset library this key reaches — the personal library for a personal key, the team

source.description: Only assets saved from these sources.

query.description: Case-insensitive part of the asset name.

favorite.description: true lists only favorites, false only assets that are not favorites.

collectionId.description: Only the assets in this folder (a collection of the same library).

entityId.description: Only the images of this character, from spicyapi_characters_list.

parameters.description: Only the assets in this folder (a collection of the same library).

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Only the images of this character, from spicyapi_characters_list.

parameters.name: favorite
parameters.description: true lists only favorites, false only assets that are not favorites.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive part of the asset name.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only assets saved from these sources.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_assets_usage_get
tool_signatures.description: Return which library the key reaches (scope), the storage plan, what is stored against its limits, how many assets were saved today against the daily limit, and the next plan with how much more to top up.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_balance_get
tool_signatures.description: Return available, held, and total balance as exact decimal USD strings when requested or diagnosing funds. Task creation already checks funds; this is not a prerequisite.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_character_get
tool_signatures.description: Read one character with its images in order, each with its uri and a fresh private previewUrl (signed for at most 20 minutes; never store it). An unknown character and one outside this key

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_characters_list
tool_signatures.description: List the characters in the asset library this key reaches: named sets of images, each image an asset with its own uri. Newest first, one page at a time; pass nextCursor back as cursor to continue.

assetId.description: Only the characters that contain this asset (ast_… or spicy://a/<id>).

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Only the characters that contain this asset (ast_… or spicy://a/<id>).

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_docs_search
tool_signatures.description: Search the bundled index of verified first-party documentation URLs.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_download_url_create
tool_signatures.description: Create a short-lived signed URL for an output owned by the current task and API key, for legacy integrations or explicit link renewal. Prefer existing ready output.assets[].url from task_get, task_wait, or a verified v2 webhook; no ticket call is needed for those links.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_model_get
tool_signatures.description: Return one exact model, its live input schema, pricing, policy and availability. Reuse a complete record already obtained from models_list with includeSchema.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_models_list
tool_signatures.description: Discover enabled models and account-specific prices. Fetch only the selected model for its schema, or set includeSchema to reuse complete records without another model_get call.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_service_status
tool_signatures.description: Read public health and readiness endpoints for diagnostics or an explicit status request. Not a prerequisite for task creation. No API key is required.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_task_create
tool_signatures.description: Obtain the exact request quote, show its USD estimate and maximum charge for user confirmation, then reserve funds and create an asynchronous task. Do not call task_quote first unless independently comparing prices.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_task_get
tool_signatures.description: Read a task created by the current API key, including ready output.assets[].url links. Use those URLs directly without your API key; query again if assets are pending or URLs have expired. A verified complete v2 webhook already contains the result. Unknown and inaccessible IDs are both 404.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_task_purge
tool_signatures.description: Permanently destroy one terminal task

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_task_quote
tool_signatures.description: Compare an exact request price without creating a task or reserving funds. Returns a five-minute USD estimate and maximum charge. task_create already obtains its own quote and confirmation; do not call this tool as a routine prerequisite.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_task_retry
tool_signatures.description: Create a new task from a failed or expired source. Requires a user confirmation round.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_task_wait
tool_signatures.description: Wait for a task for up to 300 seconds and read ready output.assets[].url directly without a download-ticket call. By default, polling backs off from about 2 to at most 10 seconds; an explicit intervalSeconds stays fixed. Prefer signed webhooks for production; a complete verified v2 callback needs no extra task_get. A local wait timeout does not cancel the task.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_tasks_list
tool_signatures.description: Discover current-key task history with metadata only, without fetching each result.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_upload_file
tool_signatures.description: Read a file from this computer, upload it, and return the spicy:// URI to put in a model input field. Use this whenever the user refers to a file on their machine. Images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF) up to 10 MiB; MP4/WebM video and MP3/WAV audio up to 90 MiB; reference documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Keynote, Pages, Numbers, TXT, Markdown) up to 90 MiB for fields such as reference_file_url. Public HTTPS media URLs need no upload at all — pass them straight to the model input when its schema accepts a URL.

path.description: Absolute path to the file on this computer, as the user gave it.

contentType.description: Only when the file extension is missing or wrong; otherwise inferred.

parameters.name: contentType
parameters.description: Only when the file extension is missing or wrong; otherwise inferred.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path to the file on this computer, as the user gave it.

tool_signatures.name: spicyapi_usage_get
tool_signatures.description: Read task counts and settled actual USD spend for the current API key, grouped by creation day and model.

from.description: Inclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to seven days before to.

to.description: Exclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to tomorrow UTC.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to seven days before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to tomorrow UTC.
